about: Onboarding kits (SNAP-R25): what to set up for each thing a person wants to make. A kit names setups (a Library recipe card, a Render Preset, a method from snap_cards/methods.json, plus a turbo or extra files); the files' folders, sizes, sources and download links come from the model graph (snap_cards/models.json), so they live in one place. Each setup has a tier (recommended, fast, also, api), the VRAM it wants, and evidence with a grade, the hardware it was measured on (`on`) and a date. Snap only proposes downloads: the person or their agent runs them. A file the model graph has no download link for (a local build) is never proposed as required: propose_downloads lists it under optional, 'no public download: bring your own file' (SNAP-R53). `extras` are optional add-ons a recipe can use but runs without (its brick starts off until they are installed): propose_downloads lists them apart, under optional, with sizes.

packs.title: Viggle Remake nodes
packs.author: Viggle
packs.license: Apache-2.0 (code); the LoRAs are a Model Derivative under the MiniMax H3 Community License
packs.unlocks: Change something · Viggle Remake and Recast: painted frames pinned at their moments, carried over the whole take
packs.command: hf download Viggle/Viggle-Remake --include "comfyui/ComfyUI-Viggle-Remake/*" --local-dir <a new empty folder> && cp -r <that folder>/comfyui/ComfyUI-Viggle-Remake "{custom_nodes}/ComfyUI-Viggle-Remake"

safety.other: 3 nodes, core imports only, the standard patcher wrapper API; no routes, file I/O, subprocess or requirements. The pack is the comfyui/ComfyUI-Viggle-Remake folder of the Hugging Face repo, not a git repo of its own: hf download it, then copy that folder
